faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ANIIMS Medical Superintendent recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Medical Superintendent post at ANIIMS is 03 October 2026. Ensure all details are submitted accurately before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Medical Superintendent post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Medical Superintendent position at the Andaman and Nicobar Islands Institute of Medical Sciences (ANIIMS) through this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Medical Superintendent role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a recognized postgraduate medical degree and have a minimum of ten years of teaching experience as a Professor or Associate Professor, with at least five years as a Professor.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Medical Superintendent position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Medical Superintendent post is 65 years. There are no specific minimum age requirements mentioned.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Medical Superintendent post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Medical Superintendent position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 2,75,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the ANIIMS Medical Superintendent recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Medical Superintendent recruitment at ANIIMS.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Medical Superintendent post at ANIIMS will be based on an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q8. What type of job is this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based job opportunity for the Medical Superintendent position at ANIIMS.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Andaman and Nicobar Islands Institute of Medical Sciences located?
faq.answer: The Andaman and Nicobar Islands Institute of Medical Sciences (ANIIMS) is located in Sri Vijaya Puram, Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the Medical Superintendent position?
faq.answer: You can apply online for the Medical Superintendent position by visiting the official website of ANIIMS or through the direct application link provided in the Important Links section before the last date of submission.
